variants.candidate: You show what you feel by making something solid rather than saying it, and what you build tends to outlast the moment.

variants.candidate: You learn by growing an idea rather than collecting it, so you understand late and keep it for good.
variants.original: Your mind gathers fuel long before it flares, and the ideas you feed patiently become the insights people call sudden.

variants.candidate: You take a rule in quietly and keep it for years, and you would rather answer to a standard you chose than to a voice raised at you.
variants.original: Pressure reaches you cool and quiet, and the calm authorities you let bank your fire are the reason it lasts the night.

variants.candidate: You are your own engine and your own company, so you do your best work beside an equal rather than under anyone's wing.
variants.original: Your strength arrives in blazes and burns out in private, and how you refill between fires decides almost everything else in your chart.

variants.candidate: Your drive goes wherever there is something hard to shape, and you finish more by picking one thing to provide for than by chasing every opening you spot.
variants.original: You act by forging, heat applied until something keeps its shape, and your money follows the finished piece rather than the bright idea.
